metrics.labelKm: គណនីមានប្រាក់ទទួលបានផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
metrics.definition: Payment classification of the selected registration cohort; not an entitlement/free-plan label
metrics.calculation: COUNT users with at least one lifetime MATCHED order with confirmedReceipt>0; noVerifiedReceiptUsers is the complementary cohort count
metrics.databaseSource: users LEFT JOIN unified matched payment ledger
metrics.dateDimension: User registration cohort; lifetime verified purchase history
metrics.includedStatuses: Nondeleted accounts; positive trusted matched cash
metrics.excludedStatuses: Zero-value orders, free entitlement alone, pending, duplicate and unverified payment claims
metrics.currencyBehavior: Positive receipt in either explicit currency; no currency amounts added
metrics.missingDataBehavior: No positive verified receipt does not prove a free plan or absence of unverified claims

metrics.labelKm: អ្នកប្រើប្រាស់សរុប
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: គណនីបានបើក
metrics.calculation: COUNT status=ACTIVE AND deleted=false; not DAU
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: គណនីបិទ
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ធៀបការសរុប
metrics.dateDimension: Selected invitation dimension; createdAt for executive
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ធៀបការបានផ្សាយ
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ធៀបការព្រាង
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ធៀបការទុកបណ្ណសារ
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: គំរូសរុប
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ភ្ញៀវមានសិទ្ធិ
metrics.calculation: COUNT persisted guest identities in filtered nondeleted event cohort
metrics.dateDimension: Selected invitation cohort, current guest snapshot
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ភ្ញៀវបានឆ្លើយ
metrics.calculation: COUNT latest valid response per eligible guest
metrics.databaseSource: rsvps JOIN guests ON guest_id AND invitation_id
metrics.dateDimension: Selected invitation cohort, current response snapshot
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ភ្ញៀវបានចូល
metrics.calculation: COUNT DISTINCT guest_id per event WHERE is_active=true
metrics.databaseSource: guest_check_ins JOIN guests ON guest_id AND invitation_id
metrics.dateDimension: Selected invitation cohort, current check-in snapshot
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: ធៀបការរយៈពេលមុន
metrics.calculation: COUNT nondeleted invitations in preceding equal calendar-day interval
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching persisted records; unavailable is null

metrics.labelKm: តម្លៃបញ្ជាទិញបរាជ័យ
metrics.dateDimension: createdAt for executive; selected dimension for ledger
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Unknown currency excluded from currency totals

metrics.labelKm: ប្រាក់ទទួលពីគំរូ
metrics.calculation: SUM confirmedReceipt WHERE productType=TEMPLATE GROUP BY currency
metrics.dateDimension: paidAt for executive; selected dimension for ledger
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Never use expected or claimant amount

metrics.labelKm: ប្រាក់ទទួលពីសមាជិកភាព
metrics.definition: Subscription portion of confirmed receipts counted once
metrics.calculation: SUM confirmedReceipt WHERE productType=SUBSCRIPTION GROUP BY currency
metrics.dateDimension: paidAt for executive; selected dimension for ledger
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Free entitlement does not imply payment

metrics.labelKm: ប្រាក់ទទួលបានផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
metrics.definition: Matched, deduplicated platform receipts; not accounting revenue
metrics.calculation: SUM(paid_amount) WHERE reconciliationOutcome=MATCHED GROUP BY currency
metrics.dateDimension: paidAt for executive; selected payment dimension for ledger
metrics.includedStatuses: PAID + trusted source + paid/confirmed timestamps + exact amount
metrics.excludedStatuses: Pending, review, failed, duplicate, mismatch, unsupported currency, missing verification
metrics.currencyBehavior: USD and KHR separate; no FX
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Missing evidence is an exception; never substitute expected amount

metrics.labelKm: តម្លៃបញ្ជាទិញរង់ចាំ
metrics.calculation: SUM(expected_amount) for pending/review records GROUP BY currency
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Unknown currency never becomes USD

metrics.labelKm: អត្រាផ្សាយ
metrics.definition: Current published state of filtered nondeleted invitation cohort
metrics.includedStatuses: PUBLISHED numerator; all nondeleted cohort denominator
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Null if denominator zero

metrics.labelKm: អត្រាឆ្លើយតប
metrics.databaseSource: guests + rsvps joined by invitation_id AND guest_id
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Null if no eligible guests

metrics.labelKm: អត្រាចូលរួម
metrics.calculation: distinct active guest_id / eligible guests; fraction 0..1
metrics.includedStatuses: is_active=true with matching invitation and guest
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Null if no eligible guests

metrics.labelKm: កំណើនតាមរយៈពេល
metrics.definition: Event creation in selected interval versus immediately preceding interval of equal calendar days
metrics.dateDimension: createdAt in Phnom Penh calendar windows
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Null; NEW_ACTIVITY when prior=0 and current>0, NO_ACTIVITY when both=0

metrics.labelKm: គណនីសកម្ម
metrics.definition: Current ACTIVE, nondeleted accounts; not DAU
metrics.calculation: COUNT users WHERE status=ACTIVE AND deleted=false
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Activity timestamp/DAU unavailable

metrics.labelKm: ចុះឈ្មោះថ្មី
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Zero means no matching registrations

metrics.labelKm: សមាជិកភាពសកម្ម
metrics.definition: Persisted active state with current validity window
metrics.calculation: is_active AND status=ACTIVE AND start<=asOf AND (end IS NULL OR end>asOf)
metrics.currencyBehavior: Purchase receipts counted only in unified ledger
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Unknown transitions/renewals/upgrades/downgrades unavailable

metrics.labelKm: ការប្រើគំរូ
metrics.definition: Nondeleted invitations created in period using template
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Conversion unavailable without persisted view denominator

metrics.labelKm: ការផ្ញើ និងការបើក
metrics.definition: Distinct guests with persisted last_sent_at / invitation_viewed_at
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Confirmed delivered unavailable; send markers are not delivery receipts

metrics.labelKm: ព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ប្រព័ន្ធ
metrics.definition: Audit actions plus notification/payment exceptions; sanitized
metrics.missingDataBehavior: Uptime and unpersisted API failures unavailable
